about.body: The AJ34S is Jaguar's 4.2-litre supercharged V8 petrol engine, produced from 2008 to 2015. It's the high-output version of the AJ34 naturally aspirated V8, fitted exclusively to the XFR variant of the X250-generation XF. The supercharger sits on top of the engine and must be removed to access the valley where the oil cooler, timing chain, and other critical components reside.

byModel.body: The AJ34S is fitted to the XF XFR (X250, 2008–2015), producing 420 hp. This is a single-application engine — the supercharged 4.2-litre V8 was reserved exclusively for the XFR variant during this generation.

compatibility.body: The AJ34S is a supercharged version of the naturally aspirated AJ34 4.2 V8, with specific tuning, supercharger hardware, and ECU calibration that differs from the standard engine. Ancillaries, mounting, ECU calibration, and supercharger tune are specific to the XFR application. Registration/VIN matching is required before any rebuild or replacement.
